scores.rationale: Large contemporary Tasmanian mixed media work, decorative but modest secondary market, likely $100-250.

Hand-knotted Hossainabad runner in good order, typical resale $100-250.
Carved Victorian medallion back settee, fresh upholstery, but soft brown-furniture market; about $200-450.
Stained, foxed 18th c style engraving of modest value; birdseye frame adds some, around $50-120.
Colonial Australian cedar two-height cottage bookcase c1865 is sought after; likely $300-700.
Decorative inlaid Edwardian burr walnut corner whatnot, typical $100-220.
Victorian papier-mache side chair with pearl inlay but worn lacquer, loose fringe and losses; about $60-150.
English 19th c Windsor armchair with crinoline stretcher; timber likely elm/oak not yew, about $150-350.
Heavy marble basin, possibly hammam kurna, stained but decorator appeal; roughly $100-300.
